integrity: The displayed claims follow from the modular exponent argument; the reproducible finite checks are corroboration, not infinite certificates. Existing two-dimensional and F4 cases are credited to prior work.
limitations: Only weighted single directed cycles with nonzero weights are classified; base-field linear automorphisms, not arbitrary semilinear or group-scheme points.
A plausible 2025 2LI automorphism study could contain implicit coverage; its complete text was not accessible and independent scholarly review remains necessary.
title: Weighted cyclic evolution algebras: finite-field forms and an arithmetic splitting criterion
